test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

XPC, QHT, JZK, CRB, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a827e903e52c199d8cea030f3655db9b02da63af4503920b2e34c4d18d2c5d.png] 

**The pattern followed in the given series is:** 

 
• First alphabet is decreased to 7 positional values.
 
• Second alphabet is decreased to 8 positional values.
 
• Third alphabet is decreased to 9 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59e2d85e89c81154e677b1156b2484755bea05594a32aebb5b4af4001347dc60.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 2).**
